subject.text: WARNING: do not open the Invoice_Okt attachment

body.text: We are handling a security incident. Do not open the Invoice_Okt attachment, no matter who sent it.
If you already opened it, turn off your laptop's Wi-Fi and call the helpdesk at ext. 110.

explanation: This warning comes from the real office domain, has no links, and gives the right steps. Employees need to get this email, so allow it.
hints: The subject sounds worrying. But who is the sender?
Does this email ask for data, money, or a click on a link?
